source_review.notes: Checked every structured reference against the live primary page. All four Kimball Group technique pages, three Microsoft dimensional-modeling pages, and two current PostgreSQL documentation pages returned HTTP 200. Claims about measurement facts, descriptive dimensions, additive categories, factless coverage, fact-table keys and grouping/aggregate behavior are scoped to those sources.

evidence: Reviewed the measure tuple M=(X,A,D,U,N,W,C), fact population S, dimension-key mappings and additive, count, distinct-count, ratio, weighted-mean and as-of-balance definitions.
Checked index domains, set cardinality, non-null restriction for distinct counts, positive/zero denominator qualifications and time-selection notation.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Symbols distinguish stored inputs, semantic aggregation, compatible dimensions, units, missingness, time selection and constraints without treating numeric type as measure semantics.

evidence: Executed fact-measure-audit with Python 3.14.4 and reproduced net revenue 395, cost 260, profit 135, ratio-of-sums margin 34.1772%, average line margin 34.7222%, latest inventory 18 and summed snapshots 28.
Independently recomputed line margins 60/180, 30/80 and 45/135; their unweighted mean is 34.7222%, while 135/395 is 34.1772%.
Recomputed Exercise 2 as store rates 10% and 40%, unweighted mean 25%, and population rate 41/110=37.2727%.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The first snippet run exposed and corrected an erroneous 33.6111% prose expectation before review completion; the final chapter and executable expectation now agree.

evidence: Expanded the two-row ratio-of-sums minus unweighted-average expression to (d1-d2)(r1-r2)/(2(d1+d2)).
Verified the many-row ratio is a denominator-weighted mean of component ratios when denominators are positive.
Checked subgroup-average rollup as sum_j(n_j*mean_j)/sum_j(n_j) and the fact that distinct-set cardinalities are not additive under overlap.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Equality cases are qualified rather than claiming the two ratio calculations always differ; zero denominators are delegated to the explicit measure policy.

evidence: Reviewed additive, semi-additive, non-additive, derived, factless, transaction, periodic-snapshot and accumulating-snapshot cases.
Reviewed null versus zero, empty groups, zero denominators, negative adjustments, mixed currencies/units, missing snapshots and irregular observation intervals.
Reviewed duplicate facts, nullable keys, unknown/not-applicable/error members, overlapping historical dimensions, late facts and conflicting as-of ties.
Reviewed direct fact-to-fact fanout, role-playing dates, overlapping distinct populations, eligibility versus activity and allocation/attribution weights.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Each boundary is paired with a contract choice, rejection path, classified special member or reconciliation control instead of an implicit default.

evidence: Traced process, grain, resolution, context, measure, additivity, component, alignment, reconciliation and evolution invariants through the sixteen-step mechanism.
Confirmed all stored fact examples remain single-valued at their declared grain and every cross-fact comparison aggregates each fact independently first.
Checked the executable profit identity against both aggregate subtraction and sum of row profits.
Checked all ten examples for an explicit fact population, dimension role or aggregation rule.
invariant_checking.notes: The module consistently treats formula, population, units, time and exceptional behavior as one measure contract.

evidence: Verified the proof starts from n_i=d_i*r_i for positive denominators and uses a common denominator without dropping a sign.
Verified the derived difference vanishes for equal denominators or equal ratios and may also vanish under broader cancellation in larger populations.
Confirmed the proof supports denominator weighting but does not claim every business ratio should share one denominator definition.
proof_review.notes: The result is labeled as a proof sketch and its positivity and business-population premises are explicit.

evidence: Located the sole formal derivation under the explicit label 'Proof sketch — ratio of sums differs from an unweighted average of ratios.'
Checked that surrounding equations are definitions rather than mislabeled universal theorems.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: The chapter does not imply external formal verification or generalize beyond the stated aggregation premises.

evidence: The executable fixture is explicitly described as exact integer teaching arithmetic rather than production or performance evidence.
Examples and exercises are presented as synthetic scenarios; no benchmark, production prevalence or causal claim is made.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Observed local execution establishes the fixture's behavior only; it is not presented as evidence about warehouse engines or real organizations.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed the separation of process, grain, fact observation, dimension context, stored input and semantic measure. Additivity is classified per dimension and unit, factless coverage is distinguished from activity, and conformance requires semantic compatibility rather than matching names.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed implementation guidance for surrogate and natural identities, role-playing dates, special dimension members, late resolution, cross-fact alignment, currency/unit handling, explicit measures, reconciliation, monitoring and definition migration. The workflow yields concrete model, test and operational artifacts.

pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter progresses from classification through aggregation algebra to modeling and operations; the compact fixture reveals two common errors; ten varied examples cover the main patterns; and five exercises require classification, computation, snapshot design, factless coverage and multi-fact synthesis with corresponding worked answers.

limitations: Internal evidence record only. No external academic, Kimball Group, Microsoft, PostgreSQL, data-warehouse practitioner, finance, statistics, semantic-layer or production review is claimed. The synthetic exact-arithmetic fixture does not validate engine-specific performance, approximate distinct algorithms, currency markets, accounting policy or organization-specific metric definitions.
